text:
Hannah Lee: Heads-up 5: candidate Priya Patel is breastfeeding and will need a 10min pumping break midway if we do a longer loop. Shes available next Thu 4:45-6:00pm PT and asked for a single compact 45min slot starting 5:05pm. Can the panel accommodate a short break?

Oliver Grant: 5:05pm start is fine. We can split 25/15 and leave a 5-10m pause in between. Remote ok.

Maya Singh: I can do 5:05-5:50. Im happy to be flexible. If she prefers onsite we'll need a private lactation room reservation.

Facilities Bot: Lactation room note: Room L2 is designated lactation room; please reserve for 5:15-5:30 PT if candidate opts to come onsite. Building access and guest badge can be arranged.

Hannah Lee: I'll pre-approve a $60 caregiving stipend and note it in the candidate record. Policy: submit receipts to Expensify with code "CARE-INTERVIEW"; approval must be logged pre-reimbursement.

Recruiter - Jess: DMed Priya with options (remote or onsite + lactation room). Priya replied: "Remote preferred but appreciate the option. 5:05pm works; I'll need a 10min break around halfway. Thank you."

Oliver Grant: Cool. Can we add a 1-line note in the invite: "There will be a 5-10min private pause in the middle of the loop for candidate needs." Also include Zoom + backup Meet.

Maya Singh: Agree. No recordings. Also reserving Quiet Room H1 as backup if candidate chooses to come onsite.

Hannah Lee: Calendar invite sent with Zoom + Meet, lactation room reserve as backup, stipend pre-approval, and short prep note. Invite snippet: ```
Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/555666777
Passcode: RedwoodCare
Backup Meet: https://meet.google.com/lactation-backup
Start: Thu 2026-05-28 17:05 PT
Agenda: 17:05-17:30 technical (Oliver), 17:30-17:40 private pause (candidate), 17:40-17:50 culture/wrap (Maya)
```

Recruiter - Jess: I'll cc people-ops receipts inbox and confirm stipend flow after the interview. Priya confirmed invite.

Candidate - Priya: Thanks everyone  appreciate the flexibility and the lactation room backup. I'll join remote unless plans change.

Hannah Lee: Thanks team  will follow up post-interview with expense instructions and quick interviewer notes. :heart:
